ideas.title: Following the Money in Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of alleged childcare fraud, including the Feeding Our Future program.
questions: What is the scope of the alleged fraud?
How much money is at risk?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover the extent of the alleged fraud and identify potential vulnerabilities in the system. By following the money, we may be able to expose the root causes of the fraud and hold those responsible accountable.
